summary: The Gabelli Utility Trust filed an 8-K reporting that Mario J. Gabelli, a key figure, was hospitalized after a medical incident. His condition is improving but return timeline is unknown. GAMCO implemented its succession plan, naming Christopher J. Marangi as President. Day-to-day operations continue under co-CEOs and the Gabelli Value team co-CIOs lead portfolio management. No deal terms, financial transactions, or strategic corporate actions are disclosed. The filing is an informational update on a leadership disruption, not a special situation event.
